subject: Recap & Next Steps — Executive priorities, gating risks, and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@horizoncare.com>, Rajesh Menon <r.menon@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 13:04:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & Next Steps — Executive priorities, gating risks, and procurement timeline

Hi Ellen / Rajesh —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from the sponsor-level discussion and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for procurement and the security review.

High-level business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce per-inference unit cost ~25–35% on high-volume pipelines (customer messaging + clinical summarization)
- Achieve sub-150ms P95 latency for 1k concurrent users in primary region
- Maintain data residency in US-only regions and ensure audit logging for PHI workflows

Primary pain/risk items called out:
1) Security & compliance: SOC 2 attestation, data retention controls, and access logs for audits
2) Procurement gating: internal procurement needs a clear SOW + pilot pricing and an expected procurement decision by end of Q1 2027
3) Ops integration: integration with your model governance pipeline and a technical design for private deployment/VPC

Immediate proposal / next steps (timeline in parentheses):
- Deliver pilot scope doc + SOW draft (Grace) — by Wed 12/23
- Provide security evidence checklist and SOC2 summary + architecture diagram (Grace / Security) — by Fri 12/25
- Procurement kickoff: connect Redwood legal with HorizonCare procurement (Rajesh to confirm contact) — target week of 1/4
- Schedule technical deep-dive with HorizonCare infra/ML infra (Marcus + Jasmine) — propose 1/6 or 1/7

Attachments included: pilot_scope_v1.docx (pilot success criteria & sizing), security_evidence_checklist_v2.xlsx (requested evidence matrix).

Two asks for you: (1) confirm the procurement contact and the internal deadline that procurement owns, (2) confirm the pilot acceptance criteria listed in the attached doc or flag any missing success metrics.

I will loop in our legal and security leads once we have your procurement contact.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@horizoncare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Menon <r.menon@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps — Executive priorities, gating risks, and procurement timeline

Grace —

Appreciate the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side after internal huddle:
- Procurement contact: procurement@horizoncare.com (cc'd here). They will need a line-item pilot SOW and firm per-unit pilot pricing.
- Timeline: our leadership is aligned to run the pilot in January, with a procurement decision aimed for the last week of January (end of month). If you can get the SOW + evidence before the 29th we should be able to keep that cadence.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report is required. We also need a network architecture diagram showing VPC peering and where logs are retained.

A couple of additional asks:
- Can Redwood provide a representative sample of the audit logs (schema) we would collect during the pilot?
- For the latency KPI, please include a testing matrix (payload sizes, concurrency, region) in the pilot plan so our SREs can validate performance claims.

I will introduce procurement formally to our legal; they may request a redline to your standard MSA.

Thanks —
Ellen Park
VP, Clinical Operations
HorizonCare Systems
ellen.park@horizoncare.com

On Mon, Dec 21, 2026 at 1:04 PM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Ellen / Rajesh —
> 
> Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from the sponsor-level discussion and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for procurement and the security review.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@horizoncare.com>, Rajesh Menon <r.menon@horizoncare.com>, procurement@horizoncare.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps — Executive priorities, gating risks, and procurement timeline

Ellen / Rajesh / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping procurement in. Short updates on our side:
- Pilot scope (attached) now includes the testing matrix for latency (payloads: 512B, 2KB, 8KB; concurrency: 100/500/1k) and expected monitoring hooks.
- Security evidence: attached checklist plus a link to the architecture diagram (redwood_architecture_diagram.pdf) — that includes details on VPC peering, KMS integration, and audit log retention locations.
- Audit logs sample: attached a one-page CSV example (schema only) showing token-level events, request IDs, timestamps, and user role.

Proposed firm dates:
- Pilot kickoff: week of 1/10 (3-week pilot)
- Pilot completion & acceptance review: week of 1/31
- Procurement decision target: 1/31

If procurement needs the SOW redline earlier I can push our legal to prioritize. Marcus and Jasmine — can you confirm availability for a technical kickoff 1/10–1/14?

Best —
Grace

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: resourcing and legal handoff for HorizonCare pilot

Grace / Jasmine —

Quick internal note before I loop legal:
- I confirmed engineering can commit a technical lead (Tara S.) and a solutions architect (me) for the pilot window 1/10–1/31.
- I'll draft the pilot SOW skeleton and share with Grace by EOD 12/22 so you can forward to procurement.
- Legal: request we pre-prepare a short SOW + pilot addendum and keep standard MSA redlines minimal (procurement often pushes for data residency clauses).

Also recommend we schedule a CTO-level 30-min sync during the week of 1/3 to align on escalation paths and SLA expectations before the pilot. Grace, please propose 2–3 time slots and I'll coordinate.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
